summary: Ticketplus Ltd. filed a 6-K reporting that on September 18, 2026 it and subsidiary Ticketplus SpA acquired 100% of Autoentrada S.A., an Argentine ticketing company based in Córdoba. Ticketplus took 10% and SpA 90%; terms, price per share and premium were not disclosed. The deal converts a white-label partner since 2019 into full operations, consistent with the August 2026 IPO strategy. Founder Eric López leads the local business; operations continue under the Autoentrada brand initially. Watch integration, margin capture and purchase-price disclosure.
